Bug_Title: Eq: Covariant equals() method defined, Object.equals(Object) inherited (EQ_SELF_USE_OBJECT)
Bug_Details:
This class defines a covariant version of the equals()
method, but inherits the normal equals(Object) method
defined in the base java.lang.Object class. 
The class should probably define a boolean equals(Object) method.
 equals() equals(Object) java.lang.Object boolean equals(Object)
Bug_Explanation: The class defines a covariant equals(CovariantEqualsBugExample) method but does not override the equals(Object) method, inheriting it from java.lang.Object. This leads to unexpected behavior when comparing objects of this class with an Object reference.
Trigger_Explanation: The testEqualsWithObjectReference method triggers the bug by comparing a CovariantEqualsBugExample instance to an Object reference, which calls Object.equals(Object) instead of the covariant equals method. This results in an unexpected behavior because the expected logic in the covariant equals method is bypassed, leading to the test failing.
